# Anoop Sinkaran
Sydney NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
Accomplished Senior Quality Engineer and Test Lead with over 19 years of hands-on experience directing end-to-end test strategies, quality governance, and integration assurance across regulated financial services, digital payments, and cloud platforms. Proven track record leading multi-disciplinary QA teams through complex digital transformations—including platform migrations to cloud environments—while driving defect triage, data integrity validation, and strict quality gate enforcement. Collaborative delivery leader skilled in aligning cross-functional business, architecture, engineering, and security stakeholders to mitigate risk, optimize CI/CD pipelines, and deliver secure, production-ready solutions.

## Core Competencies & Technical Skills
- **Test Leadership & Strategy:** Master Test Planning, Risk-Based Testing, Quality Gates, Defect Triage & Prioritization, End-to-End Traceability, Cross-Functional Release Management, Release Readiness, Dual BA/QA Requirements Ownership
- **Integration & Data Validation:** API Gateway Testing, Data Integrity Validation, Event-Driven & Message Processing, ISO/APACS Standards, Source-to-Target Verification, Failure Mode Analysis, Reconciliation Testing
- **Payment & Domain Expertise:** Android Payment Terminal Architecture, Card Payment Processing & Schemes, Digital Wallets, Terminal Licensing & Onboarding Gateways, Financial Systems
- **Test Automation & Non-Functional:** Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, Robolectric, Mobile Security Framework (MobSF), Static Security Analysis
- **CI/CD, DevOps & Tools:** Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitHub, Slack API Integration, JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, HP ALM, Dynatrace
- **Languages & Frameworks:** Kotlin, Python, Java, C#, SQL, UNIX Shell Scripting, .NET, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Jetpack Compose
- **Artificial Intelligence & Tooling:** Custom Copilot SKILL Creation, Copilot CLI, Generative AI Prompting, Automated PR Review Workflows

## Professional Experience

### Wpay (Woolworths Group) | Sydney, Australia
**Senior Quality Engineer** | November 2021 – Present
- Defined the end-to-end quality architecture for a distributed Android payment terminal solution using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose to ensure high operational resilience and seamless customer touchpoints.
- Formulated comprehensive test strategies, documentation, and pilot programs to validate ISO/APACS card payment message structures, failure modes, and transaction integrity prior to mass market rollout.
- Functioned in a dual Business Analyst and QA leadership capacity to define user stories, design specifications, and acceptance criteria for a terminal onboarding and licensing gateway.
- Engineered Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to automate API Gateway regression suites and integrated Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) for static code and security vulnerability analysis across Android builds.
- Developed an end-to-end test automation suite using Playwright covering critical customer workflows, including gift card activation and redemption pathways.
- Automated functional, integration, and user journey tests for native iOS and Android payment applications using Android Espresso and iOS XCUITest across target device profiles.
- Designed and implemented custom GitHub Copilot SKILLs, CLI prompts, and automated pull request review workflows to detect breaking changes and coverage gaps early, substantially lowering code review overhead.
- Accelerated test execution across core payment components by coupling AI tools with the Robolectric framework to unit test Coroutines, ViewModels, and Activities.
- Spearheaded quality engineering, non-functional testing, and architectural design feedback for an unattended EV charging payment initiative to validate unattended transaction flows.

- Delivered risk-based quality assurance strategies and automated testing support across client enterprise web applications to ensure robust integration and deployment readiness.

**QA Lead / Senior Automation Test Analyst** | April 2019 – April 2021
- Led the QA team through an enterprise platform transformation from a legacy LAMP stack to a cloud-native .NET and React application, ensuring end-to-end quality and data integrity across systems.
- Directed cross-functional release management cycles, alignment sessions, and daily defect triage meetings with engineering and business stakeholders to enforce quality gates and manage delivery risk.

### Seven West Media | Sydney, Australia

- Formulated automated testing frameworks for media publishing platforms, streamlining sprint delivery cycles and strengthening regression test coverage.

- Executed master test strategy, test planning, and functional end-to-end test execution for the high-volume Opal Travel ticketing platform.
